$comment: Execution order for the SQL files in this folder, used by the deploy seed runner
(src/database/seed/seed-runner.ts). Order matters where one seed reads rows another
one inserts. A .sql file that is not listed here still runs — appended after these,
in file-name order, with mode 'always' — so a new independent seed needs no edit here.
mode: 'always' (default) re-runs every deploy; every file below is idempotent.
mode: 'once' runs one time only, while the file's checksum stays unchanged.

seeds.description: fixed.menu_master — the menu tree; runs first because form_section and user_menus reference menus by id
accounts.acc_voucher_types — order advance receipt voucher type
accounts.acc_voucher_seq — counter row; joins the voucher type above, plus the company/branch masters, so it must run after them and stays 'always' (it inserts nothing until those rows exist)
fixed.form_section / form_field — item master widget layout
fixed.ui_table_columns — ItemSize column on the quotation item grid
